description: Andrei Faragau, Karel van Dalen and Andrei Metrikine provide MATLAB and Maple code for a railway-track transition model. The linked TU Delft publication abstract explicitly represents the rail as an infinite Euler-Bernoulli beam on a locally variable, nonlinear Winkler foundation under a moving load. The solution combines sequential Laplace transforms with finite differences and non-reflective boundaries. The model examines wave radiation, foundation deformation and energy input near stiffness changes such as bridge or tunnel transitions. The model supports structural-design simulations for railway transition zones. 4TU.ResearchData provides the code deposit freely under CC BY 4.0, with 44 file descriptors including scripts and a supporting document. The paper appeared in 2019; this code deposit was published in May 2025. Coverage is an idealised one-dimensional track, without a stated real site. A limitation is that complete parameter definitions, software dependencies and measured validation evidence are not established by the inspected metadata. No code or document body was downloaded and the reported numerical behaviour was not reproduced.
